pages.text: Walking into a soul that is not your own, in the flesh, is something only a soul that has climbed a long way can do: rank VI of the Ascent, of your own soul - never the one you are visiting.$(p)Use a Bound Soulkey below that and nothing happens. Stand beside someone using their key and you are left behind.
pages.title: Guests

pages.text: A guest leaves a body behind like anyone else, back where they used the key, and it is theirs: die in a borrowed soul and your things spill where you left yourself, not at your host's feet.$(p)Looking into a soul is a different thing, with no rank needed - that is the observatory's.
